theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiTM_cc_contDiff_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (f : Rn N → ℝ) (R δ : ℝ), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → (∀ z, f z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < R - 1) → 0 < δ → ∃ φ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧ (∀ z, |φ z - f z| ≤ δ) ∧ ∀ z, φ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < R
